_about: LIVE-DERIVED golden cases (MISTAKE-CALC-1, 2026-10-28): a grading defect met on the DEPLOYED product, kept as a standing case. The question and the typed answer are the ones graded live, byte for byte (mathematics only: no name, no account, no PII). Graded through BOTH entry points with the live request shapes CI-SINGLE (/api/check-solution) and the typed set (/api/grade-worksheet), exactly as an A17 case (lib/planner.cjs S.LIVE.* / W.LIVE.*), and scored by lib/score.cjs as `live_cases` (a row passes only when EVERY stated expectation holds: marks, mistake type, charged, metered share). label: LIVE

cases.source: Live new-student audit, 28 Oct 2026 (~11:00 IST), Check & Improve single, typed answer. Graded 2/3 with the lost mark typed conceptual (the defect).

question.text: Find the HCF of 96 and 404 by the prime factorisation method. Hence, find their LCM.
question.subject: Maths

cases.why: Both factorisations, the HCF and the LCM's factors (highest powers 2^5 × 3 × 101) are right: the student knows the method. Only the multiplication is wrong (2^5 × 3 × 101 = 9696, written 9690). CLAUDE.md §13 / owner ruling (7): PERFORMED wrongly = calculation; tell-tale: the student's other steps prove they know the method, so it is NOT conceptual. The slip costs the value point ONCE (½); the closing line 'So HCF = 4 and LCM = 9690' restates the carried value and earns nothing extra nor loses anything again (ECF, CBSE 'penalized only once'): 2.5/3.
